evals.prompt: Create a short 5-slide deck about the architecture of this project. Focus on how the build system works and how decks get deployed. Use the cloudflare preset.
evals.expected_output: A complete Slidev deck with deck.spec.md, slides.md, styles/tokens.css, styles/theme.css, and styles/index.css. The deck should reference real files from this repo (tools/build.py, deploy workflow) and use cloudflare preset tokens.

assertions.name: has-deck-spec
assertions.check: deck.spec.md exists in outputs

assertions.name: has-slides-md
assertions.check: slides.md exists in outputs

assertions.name: has-tokens-css
assertions.check: styles/tokens.css exists in outputs

assertions.name: has-styles-index
assertions.check: styles/index.css exists in outputs

assertions.name: slide-count-is-5
assertions.check: slides.md contains exactly 5 slides (count slide separators)

assertions.name: references-build-py
assertions.check: slides.md mentions tools/build.py, build pipeline, or the build system with specific details from the repo

assertions.name: uses-cloudflare-tokens
assertions.check: tokens.css contains warm cream/orange color values consistent with the cloudflare preset

assertions.name: no-hardcoded-colors
assertions.check: No hex/rgb/hsl color literals inside <style scoped> blocks in slides/layouts/components — must use var(--deck-*) tokens

evals.prompt: I need a 7-slide pitch deck for a developer tool startup. The product is an API monitoring service that catches breaking changes before they hit production. Target audience is VPs of engineering. Use editorial-dark.
evals.expected_output: A complete Slidev deck with deck.spec.md, slides.md, and styles. Should use editorial-dark preset (Playfair Display, near-black bg). Clear narrative arc. No generic AI phrases. Progressive reveal on dense slides.

assertions.name: has-deck-spec
assertions.check: deck.spec.md exists in outputs

assertions.name: has-slides-md
assertions.check: slides.md exists in outputs

assertions.name: slide-count-is-7
assertions.check: slides.md contains exactly 7 slides

assertions.name: uses-editorial-dark
assertions.check: tokens.css has dark background color and references Playfair Display font

assertions.name: no-generic-phrases
assertions.check: slides.md does not contain 'Let's dive in', 'In conclusion', 'Without further ado', or similar generic stock phrases

assertions.name: has-v-clicks
assertions.check: slides.md contains at least one <v-clicks> or <v-click> for progressive reveal

assertions.name: no-emoji
assertions.check: slides.md contains no emoji characters

assertions.name: no-hardcoded-colors
assertions.check: No hex/rgb/hsl color literals inside <style scoped> blocks in slides/layouts/components — must use var(--deck-*) tokens

evals.prompt: Update the demo deck at examples/demo/slides.md — slide 8 ('The toolkit') is too dense. Split it into two slides: one for transitions and visual effects, one for data visualization and design guardrails.
evals.expected_output: Updated slides.md where the original slide 8 is now two separate slides. Content preserved, just reorganized. deck.spec.md updated to reflect new slide count.

assertions.name: slide-count-increased
assertions.check: Output slides.md has 12 slides (original had 11, one was split into two)

assertions.name: transitions-content-preserved
assertions.check: Output contains 'transitions' and 'visual effects' content from the original slide

assertions.name: dataviz-content-preserved
assertions.check: Output contains 'data visualization' and 'design guardrails' content from the original slide

assertions.name: other-slides-unchanged
assertions.check: Slides before and after the split point are substantially identical to the original

assertions.name: spec-updated
assertions.check: deck.spec.md exists and reflects the new slide count or structure
